primary: At least one native YAMNet frame has top-1 in speech_classes; score ties use lowest official class index. No score threshold or post-hoc tuning.
secondary: Official inference example: mean over all native frames then top-1 in the same speech set. Descriptive only; primary determines provisional pass.
temporal: Native 0.96s patches / 0.48s hop; waveform support includes 25ms STFT with final padding. Export nominal patch and effective waveform support.
positive_scope: User-confirmed existing listening clip, with saved +/-2s context, remains positive even if music/moans coexist. Candidate-core timings are STT estimates, NOT human utterance times. Core-only reruns are descriptive and have no independent user truth.
truth: 13 user-confirmed speech-presence clips; Japanese wording and exact boundaries remain UNVERIFIED; 01/02 share context, not 13 independent utterances. 14 explicit USER typed negatives. No labels or transcripts passed to model.
r2: Preserve 2 UNVERIFIED candidates separately, excluded from inference and metrics.
pass: primary true positives >=10/13 AND false positives <=1/14 AND all input evidence verified
interpretation: YAMNet audio-event scores are not calibrated probabilities of Japanese linguistic dialogue; mixed/ambiguous outputs never change human labels.
